main.description: This lexicon is in a not officially released state. It is subject to change. | A declaration of the status of the actor. Only one can be shown at a time. If there are multiple, the latest record should be picked and earlier records should be deleted or tombstoned.

time.description: The datetime at which the status was recorded.

expiry.description: The datetime after which the status is no longer current. If unavailable, default to 10 minutes after the start time.
